# fprint-control-center

> High-performance PyQt6 GUI control center and background system tray daemon for `fprintd` fingerprint devices on Arch Linux, CachyOS, and Linux laptops with touchpad fingerprint scanners.

## Core Features & System Architecture
- **USB Power Management**: Prevents USB autosuspend scan timeouts by writing `power/control=on` and `power/persist=1` to sysfs for Synaptics (`06cb:*`) and generic fingerprint sensors.
- **360° Fingerprint Enrollment Stages**: Configurable enrollment scan positions (5, 8, or 12 angles) via D-Bus `net.reactivated.FPrint.Device`.
- **Password Manager & PAM Bridge**: Integration with `/etc/pam.d/sudo`, `/etc/pam.d/keepassxc`, and graphical `SUDO_ASKPASS` helpers (`kaskpass`, `zenity`).
- **Defensive D-Bus Wrapper**: Silent guard clause exception handling for `net.reactivated.FPrint` with backoff retries (`src/fprint_manager.py`).
- **Systemd Integration**: Runs as a user daemon (`systemd/fprint-control-center.service`).

## System Requirements & Technical Stack
- **Language**: Python 3.10+
- **GUI Framework**: PyQt6 (`PyQt6.QtWidgets`, `PyQt6.QtCore`, `PyQt6.QtGui`)
- **System Daemon**: `fprintd` (D-Bus service `net.reactivated.FPrint`)
- **Supported Distributions**: Arch Linux, CachyOS, Manjaro, EndeavourOS, Debian/Ubuntu with `fprintd`.
